algorithm_contract.reward: harness_r1_searchqa.reward.reward_func score == delta_score; no validity bonus
algorithm_contract.group_normalization: center rewards within each group; unbiased sample std (correction=1) plus 1e-6; no batch advantage whitening
algorithm_contract.reduction: mean of response-token losses per sample, then mean of eight samples
algorithm_contract.kl: disabled by default (coefficient zero); optional low_var_kl against immutable fresh SFT reference
algorithm_contract.constant_groups: retain with zero advantages and log the condition; execute all four AdamW steps, with optimizer momentum and weight decay still active
algorithm_contract.thinking: apply_chat_template(enable_thinking=true, add_generation_prompt=true); require opening <think> prefill; generated continuation alone receives loss
algorithm_contract.checkpoint_load: require qwen3_5_text fresh SFT and strict HF loading with no missing/unexpected/mismatched tensors. Model EOS must equal tokenizer im_end EOS (248046); rollout explicitly stops on that id. Rotary buffers remain FP32.
algorithm_contract.truncation: reject overlong prompts; length-terminated responses retain their tokens, like the unmasked upstream default

adaptation_differences: PyTorch FSDP FULL_SHARD replaces Megatron tensor-parallel training; FP32 master parameters and AdamW states are sharded across four or eight ranks.
GPU-resident sharded AdamW replaces the upstream precision-aware CPU-offloaded Adam implementation.
vLLM TP engines replace SGLang. Processed generation logprobs include temperature and top-p sampling transformations; TIS corrects their mismatch to temperature-scaled training probabilities.

vLLM 0.19.1 ships Qwen3_5ForCausalLM but does not register it. The rollout process and spawned TP workers lazily register this installed native text class through a worker-extension import hook, without changing shared packages or reconstructing a VLM.
Rollout engines explicitly use gdn_prefill_backend=triton. The default FlashInfer GDN prefill failed the parent's real 9B request because node4 has no nvcc/CUDA_HOME; target 4B serving is unaffected.
Rollout subprocesses set VLLM_PLUGINS empty to prevent unrelated shared-environment plugins (including awex_adapter, which imports absent Megatron) from altering native model registration.
Actor BF16 HF checkpoints are exported on disk after every update. Fresh vLLM engines reload that directory for the next rollout, including a final reload-only verification.
FP32 local actor shards, AdamW state and RNG are also persisted per rank for exact optimizer continuation on the same world size.
Distributed scheduling consumes each 32-sample batch once in four eight-sample minibatches, not four passes over the batch.
Train packet selection cycles a deterministic shuffled dataset order.

launch.resume: Use --resume <previous-output>/checkpoint-NNNNNN with a fresh --output directory and the identical --model, data, reward config, source code, seed, config and world size. Set --updates to the total desired online update count.
requirements: Parent supplies the fresh text-only qwen3_5_text SFT checkpoint and train packet JSONL; do not substitute the untouched official VLM base.
Four or eight disjoint actor GPUs plus two rollout GPUs. GPU ids in the example must be replaced with allocated physical ids.
Frozen SearchQA target and BM25 endpoints in reward YAML must be running on separate resources; a lost endpoint aborts rather than generating zero rewards.
Sufficient host memory to load the FP32 model on each rank, and disk for per-rank FP32 actor/Adam shards plus BF16 HF exports. The implementation is not a single-GPU full-Adam worker.
If using optional KL, budget an additional sharded immutable SFT reference on actor GPUs.
